summary: Two or three new Venturis, changed in bore shape only, that hold a steady dose on piped flow from 6 to 100+ L/min, still dose at 6 L/min, and don't overflow the handpump.
Round 1 of the 2-D shape screen is running. Of the existing designs, V2 (16 mm throat) holds dose most evenly on piped flow, but no existing design meets the 6–100 L/min target yet.

Throat size trades high-flow overdosing (small throats) against weak low-flow suction (large throats). The 1-D estimate puts the best throat at about 16.5–17 mm, with a narrower outlet so the bottom stays full at 6 L/min.

designs.note: Spread = highest / lowest dose on piped flow, 3-D CFD with the long-radius reducer. 6–100 is extrapolated past the 60 L/min data. Overflow = steady flow at which the Afridev level reaches +5.8 cm. V2–V4 used the older mesh; finalists will be rerun on the corrected mesh.

actions_lab: 3-D check of finalists, both reducers, 6–120 L/min
CAD (threaded, water path probed), report, bench sheet
actions_bench: Needle-valve test: bleach flow at 5 / 10 / 20 / 40 cm suction
Pipe rig: dose + port suction at 6–100 L/min
Print and test the top two designs
findings: Suction = water column below the port + a throat term growing with flow². With the needle valve's viscous feed, small throats overdose at high flow and large throats underdose at low flow. Best balance for 6–100 L/min: about 16.5–17 mm.
Almost all low-flow suction comes from the column below the port. In a 26 mm outlet at 6 L/min the water moves only as fast as an air bubble rises; a narrower outlet keeps it full.
Handpump weak dosing is air, not suction.
Two-phase CFD: when the pump-head level drops below the inlet bore, air reaches the Venturi and the dose halves. Shape moves this window but can't widen it much.
V1 already meets the handpump band.
Bench V1 stays within 0.1–1.5 mg/L from 7 to 26 L/min; the new design must not lose that.

bench.note: V1 with the long-radius reducer, Nov 23.

log: New goal: steady piped dosing 6–100+ L/min, bore shape only. Vent idea dropped. Round 1 2-D screen started. Project homepage added.
